github.transport: GitHub REST API; Contents read/write token on the Windows PC only
github.verification: Real technical request, signed JPEG response, and proposed transcription receipt checked against SQLite; ordinary ChatGPT write access is separate.

chatgpt.verification: User relayed the exact random challenge from an ordinary ChatGPT chat and it matched the technical JPEG.
chatgpt.reason: The standard ChatGPT GitHub app is read-only. JSON requests/results require manual relay or a separately available authorized writing client; the server token does not add chat tools.

runtime_status: Static capability description; inspect authenticated /api/integration for actual sync status.
